# Get Login Message By Account

GET https://localhost:5000/gw/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/login-messages

Query login messages assigned by accountId**Scope**: `accounts.read`**Security Policy**: `HTTPS`

Reference: https://ibkrcampus.com/docs/web-api/api-reference/account-management/account-management-accounts/get-accounts-login-messages

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — RS256-signed JWT access token signed with your registered private key.

## Servers

- `https://localhost:5000` (Client Portal Gateway, default)
- `https://api.ibkr.com` (Production)
- `https://qa.interactivebrokers.com` (Sandbox)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `accountId` (string, required)

### Query parameters

- `type` (string, optional)

## Response

### 200

Query login messages assigned by accountId

- `accountId` (string, optional)
- `clearingStatus` (string, optional)
- `clearingStatusDescription` (string, optional)
- `loginMessages` (list of LoginMessage, optional)
- `loginMessagePresent` (boolean, optional)

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

Returns error description representing bad request

- `type` (string, optional)
- `title` (string, optional)
- `status` (long, optional)
- `detail` (string, optional)
- `instance` (string, optional)

### 401 Unauthorized Error

Returns error description representing access issue

- `type` (string, optional)
- `title` (string, optional)
- `status` (long, optional)
- `detail` (string, optional)
- `instance` (string, optional)

### 403 Forbidden Error

Returns error description representing access issue

- `type` (string, optional)
- `title` (string, optional)
- `status` (long, optional)
- `detail` (string, optional)
- `instance` (string, optional)

### 500 Internal Server Error

Returns error description representing internal server error

- `type` (string, optional)
- `title` (string, optional)
- `status` (long, optional)
- `detail` (string, optional)
- `instance` (string, optional)

## Types

### LoginMessage

- `recordDate` (datetime, optional)
- `id` (long, optional)
- `username` (string, optional)
- `messageType` (string, optional)
- `contentId` (long, optional)
- `state` (string, optional)
- `description` (string, optional)
- `tasks` (list of long, optional)

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"io"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://localhost:5000/gw/api/v1/accounts/accountId/login-messages"

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", url, nil)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}
```

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = ["Authorization": "Bearer <token>"]

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://localhost:5000/gw/api/v1/accounts/accountId/login-messages")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)
request.httpMethod = "GET"
request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```
